Error400.description: Invalid JSON, unknown/duplicate field, null, invalid type, or invalid request.

Error403.description: Invalid Host or a browser Origin request.

Error409.description: Conflicting lifecycle operation, resource owner, or idempotency key.

Error422.description: Unsupported configuration or unmet preparation prerequisite.

Error504.description: Graceful shutdown deadline expired; retry with a new idempotency key.

ErrorDefault.description: Request or backend error; see the error code and HTTP status.

mirror.description: auto or a configured product mirror; only valid when enabled.

Environment.description: Guest startup environment; values are strings, including booleans/dates. Explicit values override product defaults, subject to CVMFS compatibility.

digest.description: OCI manifest digest for registry images; SHA-256 of the entire imported tar for local archives.

reference.description: OCI tag/digest or docker-archive:/absolute/path.tar (one native Linux image). Local archives are snapshotted by SHA-256 before import; no published-image fallback.

jupyter.description: Start authenticated Jupyter without starting Xorg. Requires jovyan, networking, and a Jupyter-first Neurodesktop image. Forwards only 127.0.0.1:host_port to guest port 8888.
Private Jupyter credentials returned only after authenticated HTTP readiness. Never log this object.

info.description: Launch NeurodeskAppX --headless. Use the loopback address and fresh bearer token from its single stdout JSON readiness line. No initial window or VM. All requests originate in the controlling process, without a browser Origin. Requests reject null and duplicate JSON keys. Mutations require UUID idempotency keys; use operation polling, not log scraping. One active VM/window per process. See headless.md for lifecycle and compatibility.
info.title: NeurodeskAppX local backend API

200.description: Authenticated desktop inspection; screenshot requires a presented Glass window.
Authenticated desktop inspection; screenshot requires a presented Glass window.

port.description: Use the port printed in the readiness handshake.
